description: This file declares exported API functions and includes licensing and copyright information specific to the BroadWay Web Resource Manager implementation. It contains function prototypes for creating, removing, enrolling, and initializing the File Manager Object related to BWRM.

methods.name: BwrmCreateFileManager
methods.description: Creates and returns a handle to the File Manager object, given container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: BwrmFmoCreate
methods.description: Creates an instance of the File Manager Object with the specified contexts.

methods.name: BwrmFmoRemove
methods.description: Removes or deallocates the File Manager Object.

methods.name: BwrmFmoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects or resources for the File Manager Object.
